name: wmkf_requestdocument-transcript-bundle
_comment: Optional typed manifest for the three-file generated transcript bundle. The field is selected only by explicit bundle callers after MEETING_TRACKER_TRANSCRIPT_BUNDLE_SCHEMA_READY=on; it contains stable file metadata, never file bytes, URLs, or transcript text.

attributes.description: Versioned stable identities, hashes, sizes, names and media types for the generated TXT/VTT/source bundle. Contains no URLs or transcript content.
